Johnson & Johnson's average quarterly gross profit in fiscal 2024 was about **$15.34 billion**. This is my best recollection of the FY2024 10-K figures, not checked against the filing.

- Net sales were $88,821 million.
- Cost of products sold was $27,471 million.
- Full-year gross profit is therefore $88,821M − $27,471M = $61,350M, a gross margin of about 69.1%.
- The average per quarter is $61,350M ÷ 4 ≈ $15,337.5 million.
